parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: A complete tree with bag probabilities $\frac12,\frac12$; first-pick red/blue probabilities $\frac7{10},\frac3{10}$ for X and $\frac45,\frac15$ for Y; second-pick probabilities $\frac7{10},\frac3{10}$ after XR, $\frac8{10},\frac2{10}$ after XB, $\frac45,\frac15$ after YR, and $1,0$ after YB.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:

B1 second column: four branches R, B, R, B (oe) with probabilities $\frac7{10},\frac3{10},\frac45,\frac15$ placed appropriately. B1 third column: eight branches R, B, R, B, R, B, R, [B] (oe) with probabilities $\frac7{10},\frac3{10},\frac8{10},\frac2{10},\frac45,\frac15,1,[0]$. Condone omission of the YBB branch if YBR is fully correct. Ignore extra columns. If separate trees are used for X and Y, maximum B0B1B1 if bags are clearly identified.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$P(\text{same})=P(BB)+P(RR)=\frac12\frac3{10}\frac2{10}+\frac12\frac7{10}\frac7{10}+\frac12\frac45\frac45=\frac6{200}+\frac{49}{200}+\frac{16}{50}$. B1 FT for $P(BB)=\frac12\frac3{10}\frac2{10}+\frac12\frac15(0)=\frac6{200}$, unsimplified accepted; FT from (a) only with three-term probabilities. B1 FT for either $P(XRR)=\frac12\frac7{10}\frac7{10}$ or $P(YRR)=\frac12\frac45\frac45$, with same FT condition. M1 for summing the three corresponding terms, unsimplified accepted and consistent with the tree if notation is unclear. $119/200=0.595$ (A1). Special case if $\frac12$ is consistently omitted from tree and calculation: no FT; SC B1 for BB terms, SC B1 for RR terms, SC B1 for their correct total expression.
